AKRQ.name: Acknowledgement Request
AKRQ.definition: Acknowledgement requested by the originator to the destination (used with a notification message exclusively).

AKRP.name: Acknowledgement Response
AKRP.definition: Acknowledgement response by the destination to the originator (used with a notification message exclusively).

ENDB.name: End
ENDB.definition: End of a collection or batch by the originator (used with a request message exclusively).

IDNT.name: Identification List
IDNT.definition: Contains a list of batch or collection identifications.

RERQ.name: Resend Request
RERQ.definition: A request to resend a batch or collection.

STRT.name: Start
STRT.definition: Initiation of a collection or batch by the originator (used with a request message exclusively).
